title: research: exhaust rational triple gauges in the P112 rank-34 fit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds an exact classification of every possible `GL3(Q)` matrix/inverse support pair, then prices every such map on every triple of the published PR3335 34-channel P112 factorization. The classifier reduces zero cofactors to binomial valuation constraints, checks all sign assignments and constructs explicit rational witnesses with entries `±7^z`; it does not sample a coefficient alphabet.

## Result

The classification has **487** feasible rational support maps. Across 5,984 channel triples and 2,914,208 map/triple cases, every triple's minimum full-plane invoice is unchanged. The global invoice remains **224**; no single arbitrary rational three-channel gauge improves it. All 396 maps from the earlier signed-ternary triple census are included. A determinant-two fixture checks exact preservation of all 12,544 scalar fitting-matrix entries and rejects a wrong inverse.

This is a scoped negative result. It closes one rational `GL3(Q)` move from the published basis; it does not close sequential overlapping gauges, simultaneous blocks of size four or more, other factorizations, or a physical supplier. No kappa change is claimed.

## Validation

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-triple-gauge --check-only`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-triple-gauge`
- `python3.12 -B research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-triple-gauge/verify.py`
- `python3.12 -O -B research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-triple-gauge/verify.py`

The registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.15, including normal and optimized exact censuses and five focused tests.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The exact scope, source pins, valuation classification, limits and next question are recorded in `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `CERTIFICATE.json` and `README.md`. A refreshed overlap scan covered 724 open PRs and 2,593 Discussion records at 2026-10-19 09:31 UTC. PR4004 covers signed-ternary triple gauges; this result classifies every rational 3x3 support/inverse-support pair. No novelty claim is inferred from text search.

## Credit

Matarener/Mark and Claude via Claude Code supplied PR3335's rematching and rank-34 factorization. Arham Tahir's paired-plane audit and its credited predecessors supply the full-plane tariff and 224 base invoice. Their attribution remains intact. Prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can a sequence of overlapping triple gauges, or a rational block of size four or more, lower the tariff? Build an interaction graph from the 487 exact triple support maps and screen a discriminating four-channel composition. Even a bill below 160 would pass only the optimistic copy screen; physical dirty-state realization and supplier admission would remain necessary.
